tasks.label: Core - Build Windows
args: & { fnm env --shell powershell | Out-String | Invoke-Expression; fnm use; npx deemon --kill npm run watch-client 2>$null; npm run watch-clientd }

tasks.label: React - Build Windows
args: & { fnm env --shell powershell | Out-String | Invoke-Expression; fnm use; npx deemon --kill npm run watchreact 2>$null; npm run watchreactd }

tasks.label: Kill VS Code - Build, Npm, VS Code - Build
Clean React Cache
tasks.command: rm -rf src/vs/workbench/contrib/void/browser/react/out/* && rm -rf src/vs/workbench/contrib/void/browser/react/src2/* && rm -rf .build/* && rm -rf out/* && rm -rf out-build/* && rm -rf out-vscode/*

args: & { $reactOut = ''src/vs/workbench/contrib/void/browser/react/out''; $reactSrc2 = ''src/vs/workbench/contrib/void/browser/react/src2''; $buildDir = ''.build''; $outDir = ''out''; $outBuildDir = ''out-build''; $outVscodeDir = ''out-vscode''; Write-Host ''========================================''; Write-Host ''  Void Cache Cleanup'' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ''========================================''; Write-Host ''''; if (Test-Path $reactOut) { $files = Get-ChildItem -Path $reactOut -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($files) { Write-Host ''[1/6] Cleaning React compiled output...'' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Remove-Item -Path "$reactOut\*" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host ''Success: React out directory cleaned'' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host ''[1/6] React out directory is already empty, skipping'' -ForegroundColor Gray } } else { Write-Host ''[1/6] React out directory not found, skipping'' -ForegroundColor Gray }; Write-Host ''''; if (Test-Path $reactSrc2) { $files = Get-ChildItem -Path $reactSrc2 -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($files) { Write-Host ''[2/6] Cleaning React src2 cache...'' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Remove-Item -Path "$reactSrc2\*" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host ''Success: React src2 directory cleaned'' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host ''[2/6] React src2 directory is already empty, skipping'' -ForegroundColor Gray } } else { Write-Host ''[2/6] React src2 directory not found, skipping'' -ForegroundColor Gray }; Write-Host ''''; if (Test-Path $buildDir) { $files = Get-ChildItem -Path $buildDir -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($files) { Write-Host ''[3/6] Cleaning build cache...'' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Remove-Item -Path "$buildDir\*" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host ''Success: Build directory cleaned'' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host ''[3/6] Build directory is already empty, skipping'' -ForegroundColor Gray } } else { Write-Host ''[3/6] Build directory not found, skipping'' -ForegroundColor Gray }; Write-Host ''''; if (Test-Path $outDir) { $files = Get-ChildItem -Path $outDir -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($files) { Write-Host ''[4/6] Cleaning root out directory...'' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Remove-Item -Path "$outDir\*" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host ''Success: Root out directory cleaned'' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host ''[4/6] Root out directory is already empty, skipping'' -ForegroundColor Gray } } else { Write-Host ''[4/6] Root out directory not found, skipping'' -ForegroundColor Gray }; Write-Host ''''; if (Test-Path $outBuildDir) { $files = Get-ChildItem -Path $outBuildDir -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($files) { Write-Host ''[5/6] Cleaning root out-build directory...'' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Remove-Item -Path "$outBuildDir\*" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host ''Success: Root out-build directory cleaned'' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host ''[5/6] Root out-build directory is already empty, skipping'' -ForegroundColor Gray } } else { Write-Host ''[5/6] Root out-build directory not found, skipping'' -ForegroundColor Gray }; Write-Host ''''; if (Test-Path $outVscodeDir) { $files = Get-ChildItem -Path $outVscodeDir -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($files) { Write-Host ''[6/6] Cleaning root out-vscode directory...'' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Remove-Item -Path "$outVscodeDir\*" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host ''Success: Root out-vscode directory cleaned'' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host ''[6/6] Root out-vscode directory is already empty, skipping'' -ForegroundColor Gray } } else { Write-Host ''[6/6] Root out-vscode directory not found, skipping'' -ForegroundColor Gray }; Write-Host ''''; Write-Host ''========================================''; Write-Host ''  Cache cleanup completed!'' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ''========================================''; Write-Host ''''; Write-Host ''IMPORTANT: After clearing cache, you must:'' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host ''  1. First run: npm run watchreact [or React - Build task]''; Write-Host ''  2. Then run:  npm run watch-clientd [or Core - Build task]''; Write-Host ''''; Write-Host ''The React build MUST complete before watch-clientd can succeed.'' -ForegroundColor Red }
